_comment: Third-party ids for the Rockwall store (client brief, November 2026). An EMPTY value DISABLES that integration: nothing is rendered and no request is made; the previous location's ids were never carried over. Read by components/Tracking.tsx, components/ChatWidget.tsx, components/BookingPage.tsx, components/SleepQuiz.tsx (quiz webhook), scripts/integrations.mjs (the contact form embeds inside the generated pages: run `node scripts/integrations.mjs` after changing formId) and scripts/reviews-cta.mjs (reviews widget: run it after changing reviewsWidget). The dataLayer events phone_click, directions_click, booking_confirmation, optin_submit and quiz_completed (public/snz-events.js, public/sleep-fit-quiz.js) fire on every page.
_gtmId: Google Tag Manager container, shared with the other stores (confirmed in the brief); the loader in <head> at parse time and the <noscript> iframe right after <body>.
_ga4Ids: Google Analytics 4 measurement id(s): one gtag.js loader + config each, installed once (the client's snippet repeated the block twice).
_simplifiId: Simpli.fi tag: <script async src="https://tag.simpli.fi/sifitag/<id>">, once per page.
_chatWidgetId: LeadConnector chat widget ids, one per language (client brief, November 2026): English on every page outside /es, Spanish on /es and /es/*. components/ChatWidget.tsx loads https://widgets.leadconnectorhq.com/loader.js once per page (next/script lazyOnload, rendered by each root layout), never styled or positioned by the site (that is set in the CRM). The client pasted the Spanish snippet twice; it is loaded once.
_quizWebhookUrl: The Rockwall sub-account's (qR8peonBlnjGI3ZuLHQP) inbound webhook for the Sleep Fit Quiz lead (client brief, November 2026), on /sleep-quiz and /es/sleep-quiz: components/SleepQuiz.tsx passes it to public/sleep-fit-quiz.js as window.__snzQuizWebhook, which posts the lead form-encoded (the same payload as the other stores, store_id rockwall) and then shows the results screen. Empty = the lead is not sent (logged to the console).
_calendarId: The Dream Mapping booking calendar, https://link.snoozesleep.com/widget/booking/<id> on /booking (the client's embed id is <id>_1793636519475). Empty = /booking shows the phone call to action where the calendar goes.
_formId: The contact (opt-in) form 'Optin', https://link.snoozesleep.com/widget/form/<id>, on /contact-us, /about-us and the generated pages' get-in-touch sections. Empty = the pages show a card with the phone number and e-mail where the form goes. Run `node scripts/integrations.mjs` after changing it.
_reviewsWidget: The LeadConnector reviews widget, reputationhub.site/reputation/widgets/review_widget/<locationId>?widgetId=<widgetId>, once per 'Some of Our Happy Customers' section. Empty = the 'Leave us a Google review' call to action. Run `node scripts/reviews-cta.mjs` after changing it.
